name: Zarth
source:
At the end of the 21st Century, Americans completed the ultimate weapon Orion. However, the scientist Bittner used it and caused a nuclear holocaust on Earth. Those who survived inside shelters went into a cryogenic sleep, waiting for the radioactivity to reach safe levels. 100 years later, only 4500 survived the temporal travel. They built new villages and life went on.

You are Zarth from Rimanon. A woman called Mirika came with news of her village having been attacked and her people being taken by the assailant. Rimanon's village chief calls three people, you included, to investigate this case, as Nava is probably the cause of it.

Unfortunately, Zarth doesn't have time to take a rest that Nava is already on Rimanon, their many soldiers dropping from airplanes with jet packs on their back, spreading fire and death on the village!

Only Zarth and Torald were able to escape the terrible assault. They fled to the Yugg forest and are now the only hope left to stop Nava.
translation:
21世纪末，美国人完成了终极武器“猎户座”。然而，科学家比特纳使用了它，引发席卷地球的核灾难。躲进避难所的幸存者进入低温休眠，等待放射性降至安全水平。一百年后，只有4500人熬过了这场时间旅行。他们建立新的村庄，生活继续向前。

你是来自里马农的萨斯。一名叫米莉卡的女子前来报信，说她的村庄遭到袭击，村民被敌人掳走。里马农的村长召集了包括你在内的三人调查此事，因为幕后黑手很可能是纳瓦。

遗憾的是，萨斯还来不及休息，纳瓦就已经兵临里马农。大批士兵背着喷气背包从飞机跃下，将烈火与死亡散播到村庄各处！

只有萨斯和托拉尔德逃过了这场可怕袭击。他们逃入尤格森林，成为阻止纳瓦仅存的希望。
